cohort: Postpartum patients discharged from a tertiary care hospital in Haryana, India, between January 1, 2023, and January 1, 2024, after vaginal or cesarean delivery (approximately 4800 patients).
finding: 70% of patients chose male condoms, 10% wanted ligation, 10% PPIUCD, 3% injection Antara, 4% POP, and 3% did not want any method.
